display.purpose: The document's H1 in the theme's voice (1.9em, 600).

title.purpose: H3 (1.2em, 600); the outline lists H1 to H3 only.

body.purpose: Document text in the theme's voice: 18px by default (16, 18, 20, 22), line-height 1.9.

dialog-title.purpose: The Appearance dialog's heading, in the UI sans.

label.purpose: The interface's working size (12px, UI sans): buttons, menu items, segmented items, captions, notes.

hour-mark.purpose: The large hour character on each Hours swatch, always the book voice.

season-name.purpose: The theme's name on its Seasons swatch, in that theme's own voice.

code.purpose: Monospace on the code well: 14px in the editor, 13px in the reading view, 0.84em inline.

voice-book.purpose: Iowan Old Style with Songti; the page voice of eight themes (all six Hours, Mist, Harvest).

voice-clear.purpose: PingFang and the system sans; the page voice of Lotus, Moon White and Indigo.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Every dialog; the largest, softest floating layer.

shadows.name: image-tools
shadows.purpose: The image toolbar and the alt-text popover.

shadows.name: floating-sidebar
shadows.purpose: The sidebar as a drawer over the page; none when docked.

shadows.name: selected-tile-lift
shadows.purpose: Selected tile of a segmented control, the view switch and the source toggle. Light themes only; dark themes drop it for a 1px hairline.

shadows.name: selected-swatch-ring
shadows.purpose: Second pixel of the selected theme swatch's ring, in the dialog's own ring colour. A ring, not a shadow.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Hover and press states change instantly; nothing eases on hover.

motion.name: theme-crossfade
motion.purpose: Automatic switch between two themes of the same scheme; large surfaces only; text colour changes at once. Never across light and dark.

motion.name: chrome-fade
motion.purpose: Top-bar actions, sidebar button, format bar and status line in Focus mode.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Every transition and animation is removed under prefers-reduced-motion; the crossfade is not started.

themes.name: 黛蓝
themes.when: night (Follow the Seasons when the system is dark)

components.name: Hours Swatch
components.description: A small sheet of one Hours theme's own paper: hour character, name and a 2px mark line. Selected state is drawn in the dialog's ring colour, not the swatch's.
components.css: .ds-hours{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,96px);gap:6px}.ds-hour{position:relative;height:88px;padding:0 4px;border:1px solid var(--border,#d2d3cf);border-radius:8px;background:var(--card,#fafaf8);color:var(--foreground,#242523);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;text-align:center}.ds-hour b{display:block;font:500 24px/1.15 'Iowan Old Style','Songti SC','Noto Serif CJK SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif SC',Georgia,'Microsoft YaHei',serif}.ds-hour span{display:block;margin-top:8px;font-size:12px}.ds-hour::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:32%;right:32%;bottom:6px;height:2px;border-radius:1px;background:var(--primary,#4e675e)}.ds-hour[aria-checked=true],.ds-season[aria-checked=true]{border-color:var(--ring,#496f61);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ring,#496f61)}.ds-hour:focus-visible,.ds-season:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#496f61);outline-offset:2px}.ds-check{position:absolute;top:6px;right:6px;width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--ring,#496f61)}

components.name: Seasons Swatch
components.description: A Seasons theme as a colour chip: its name in its own voice, the season at the foot and a 5px mark-colour spine. The spine belongs to this swatch alone.
components.css: .ds-seasons{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,120px);gap:6px}.ds-season{position:relative;height:88px;padding:0 4px;border:1px solid var(--border,#d2d3cf);border-radius:8px;background:var(--card,#fafaf8);color:var(--foreground,#242523);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;text-align:left}.ds-season b{position:absolute;left:16px;right:8px;top:6px;bottom:30px;display:flex;align-items:center;font:600 20px/1.2 var(--voice,'Iowan Old Style','Songti SC','Noto Serif CJK SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif SC',Georgia,'Microsoft YaHei',serif)}.ds-season span{position:absolute;left:16px;bottom:10px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted-foreground,#61665f)}.ds-season::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:5px;background:var(--primary,#4e675e)}.ds-hour[aria-checked=true],.ds-season[aria-checked=true]{border-color:var(--ring,#496f61);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ring,#496f61)}.ds-hour:focus-visible,.ds-season:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#496f61);outline-offset:2px}.ds-check{position:absolute;top:6px;right:6px;width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--ring,#496f61)}

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Recessed track with a paper tile for the active choice; the Switch Automatically control. Dark themes drop the lift for a 1px hairline.
components.css: .ds-segmented{display:inline-flex;padding:2px;border:1px solid var(--border,#d2d3cf);border-radius:7px;background:var(--muted,#eeeeeb)}.ds-segmented button{padding:4px 10px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:none;color:var(--muted-foreground,#61665f);font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei UI','Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-segmented button[aria-checked=true]{background:var(--card,#fafaf8);color:var(--foreground,#242523);box-shadow:0 1px 3px #0002}.ds-segmented button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#496f61);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: View Switch
components.description: The top bar's Edit, Split, Read switch: the segmented pattern at 8px radius, 3px padding and 30px items, with a hover fill.
components.css: .ds-view{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:3px;border:1px solid var(--border,#d2d3cf);background:var(--muted,#eeeeeb);border-radius:8px}.ds-view button{height:30px;padding:0 12px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:none;color:var(--muted-foreground,#61665f);font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei UI','Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}.ds-view button:hover{color:var(--foreground,#242523);background:var(--accent,#dce3df)}.ds-view button[aria-checked=true]{background:var(--card,#fafaf8);color:var(--foreground,#242523);box-shadow:0 1px 3px #0002}.ds-view button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#496f61);outline-offset:1px}

components.name: Tool Button
components.description: The 34px icon button in the top bar and dialog heads: pencil icon, hover fill, ring on keyboard focus.
components.html: <button class="ds-tool" aria-label="外观与排版"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m15 16 2.536-7.328a1.02 1.02 1 0 1 1.928 0L22 16"/><path d="M15.697 14h5.606"/><path d="m2 16 4.039-9.69a.5.5 0 0 1 .923 0L11 16"/><path d="M3.304 13h6.392"/></svg></button>

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: The Export button: 1px hairline, 12px label with an 18px icon, hover fill. Outlined, never filled.
components.css: .ds-export{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;height:34px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid var(--border,#d2d3cf);border-radius:6px;background:none;color:var(--foreground,#242523);font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei UI','Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}.ds-export svg{display:block;width:18px;height:18px}.ds-export:hover{background:var(--accent,#dce3df)}.ds-export:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#496f61);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled button: Quick Note's Save as Draft, in the mark colour. Everywhere else the mark colour is a line.
components.css: .ds-primary{padding:8px 14px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:var(--primary,#4e675e);color:var(--primary-foreground,#ffffff);font:14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei UI','Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#496f61);outline-offset:3px}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default}

components.name: Select
components.description: Font Size, Line Width and the Light and Dark theme pickers: paper fill, 1px field line, 5px radius.
components.css: .ds-field{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--foreground,#242523);font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei UI','Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif}.ds-select{font:inherit;background:var(--card,#fafaf8);color:var(--foreground,#242523);border:1px solid var(--input,#bfc2bc);border-radius:5px;padding:6px 9px}.ds-select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#496f61);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Menu
components.description: The floating menu: floating paper, 1px hairline, 9px radius, the menu shadow; 34px items that take the hover fill.
components.css: .ds-menu{display:inline-block;min-width:220px;padding:5px;background:var(--popover,#ffffff);border:1px solid var(--border,#d2d3cf);border-radius:9px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px #0002}.ds-menu button{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;width:100%;height:34px;padding:0 9px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:none;color:var(--foreground,#242523);font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei UI','Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif;text-align:left;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}.ds-menu button:hover,.ds-menu button:focus{background:var(--accent,#dce3df);outline:none}.ds-menu button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#496f61);outline-offset:-2px}.ds-menu [role=separator]{height:1px;margin:5px 4px;background:var(--border,#d2d3cf)}.ds-menu kbd{font:11px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei UI','Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif;color:var(--muted-foreground,#61665f)}

components.name: Outline
components.description: The document outline beside the paper: unboxed pencil items indented per level; the current item takes the hover fill and the mark colour.
components.html: 大纲
components.css: .ds-outline{display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:220px;color:var(--muted-foreground,#61665f)}.ds-outline-label{padding:0 10px 12px;font:11px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei UI','Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif}.ds-outline button{display:block;width:100%;padding:8px 12px 8px 10px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:none;color:var(--muted-foreground,#61665f);font:12px/1.6 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei UI','Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif;text-align:left;overflow-wrap:anywhere;cursor:pointer}.ds-outline button:hover{background:var(--accent,#dce3df)}.ds-outline button[aria-current=location]{background:var(--accent,#dce3df);color:var(--primary,#4e675e)}.ds-outline button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#496f61);outline-offset:-2px}

narrative.overview:
Liubai is one page to write on. The chrome steps back and the page takes the colour of the hour: each of the eleven themes is a sheet of paper and a colour of ink under a particular light. Six themes follow the hours of a day (天光, Hours) and five follow the seasons of a year (四时, Seasons). The paper is the theme: pearl grey, white, ivory, charcoal, warm brown, blue-grey, grey-green, lotus pink, olive gold, moon white, deep indigo. Body text is always ink. A theme's mark colour shows only as thin lines and small marks.

The system is flat and low-interference, following the product principle of editing first. Surfaces are separated by 1px hairlines and at most one tonal step; only a layer that floats above the page casts an ambient shadow. Nothing is textured, gradient or decorative. Hover is instant. The one authored moment is the one-second crossfade when the automatic switch turns one light theme into another, or one dark theme into another, as the hour or the season changes.

Two voices speak on the page, both system fonts: a book voice (Iowan Old Style with Songti) and a clear voice (PingFang, the system sans). Each theme picks one for its page, and the chrome around the page always stays in the UI sans.

Confirmed visual rejections: the stock editor theme packs (GitHub, Solarized, Nord, Dracula) as palettes; stationery costume (ruled paper, handwriting faces); decorative paper cards and slogans around the editor (removed in 0.1.5 at the user's request).
keyCharacteristics: Eleven themes, one role vocabulary: every theme redeclares the same colour roles in `src/themes.css`, and components only read `var(--role)`.
Two series with two clocks: Hours (by local time, six themes, all in the book voice) and Seasons (by solar term, five themes, three in the clear voice).
Flat paper: no texture, no gradient, no theme-specific imagery.
Colour has jobs: ink for text, hairlines for structure, the mark colour for the caret, the current item and small marks, the link colour for links in light themes.
Dark themes separate surfaces with hairlines and one tonal step, and colour only the current thing.
System fonts only, Lucide icons only, chrome in 12 to 13px UI sans.
Exports and print ignore the theme and stay white paper.

rules.name: The Roles-Not-Hex Rule
rules.body: New UI reads roles (`var(--card)`, `var(--primary)`); theme hex lives only in `src/themes.css`. A surface that works in Paper has to work in all eleven themes. A new role is declared in all eleven theme blocks or in none.

rules.name: The Jobs Rule
rules.body: Each colour has one job: ink for text, pencil for secondary text, hairlines for structure, the mark colour for the caret, the current item and small marks, the link colour for links. Colour never carries a paragraph, and every fill is flat.

rules.name: The Night Rule
rules.body: In the four dark themes (Lamplight, Ink, Moonlight, Indigo) only the current thing is coloured: the caret, the selection, the block handle under the pointer or focus, and the current outline item. Links read as ink with a coloured underline. Code uses the muted `syntax-*` roles, held at 7:1 or more on the dark paper. A few older accent uses (the table menu button, footnote references, the toast action) still carry colour at night and are not a pattern to copy.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: A theme speaks in one voice on the page: headings and body share `--font-body`. The six Hours themes all use the book voice, so following the hours never reflows the page; the Seasons themes may differ because they change only four times a year. The chrome never takes a theme's voice.

rules.name: The System Fonts Rule
rules.body: The page and the chrome use only fonts that ship with macOS and Windows. A theme never bundles a font file or names one that needs downloading (the only font files in the app are KaTeX's math faces, used for formulas).

rules.name: The Upright Rule
rules.body: Quotes and callouts are set upright. Chinese faces have no italic, so the browser can only slant Songti or PingFang.

rules.name: The Padding Rule
rules.body: Vertical space around editor lines and block widgets is padding, never margin. CodeMirror measures lines and widgets without their margins, and a margin breaks hover, click and scroll positions.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Stacked surfaces are separated by a 1px `border` line and at most one tonal step, never by a shadow. In dark themes the selected tile drops its lift for a 1px hairline too.

rules.name: The Float Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this layer floats above the page": menus, dialogs, toasts, popovers and the floating sidebar. It is soft, near-black, 7 to 20% opaque, and never a hard offset. The one small exception is the selected tile of a segmented control, which lifts by a hair in light themes only.

rules.name: The Line Rule
rules.body: The mark colour arrives as a line, not a block: the 2px caret, the link underline at a 3px offset, the 2px quote rule, the 2px focus ring, the 2px insertion line, the 2px underline on each Hours swatch. Fills are reserved for small marks (a resize handle, a checkbox) and the one Quick Note button.

rules.name: The Outer Ring Rule
rules.body: Selection and focus on a swatch are drawn in the dialog's own ring colour, never the swatch's, so the state reads on every paper.

rules.name: The Same-Scheme Fade Rule
rules.body: Fade only between themes of the same scheme. Text flips colour instantly, so a background still fading between light and dark would leave the text unreadable for a moment.

dos: Do read colour through roles: `var(--card)` for paper, `var(--popover)` for anything that floats or docks beside the page, `var(--foreground)` for ink, `var(--muted-foreground)` for secondary text, `var(--primary)` for marks. Check a new surface in all eleven themes, not only Paper.
Do keep text ink and hold any new text pair to 4.5:1 or more; text on the hover fill (`accent`) is not gated by the theme check, so compute it by hand.
Do draw the mark colour as a line or a small mark: 2px weights, the 3px underline offset, a 2px ring.
Do separate stacked surfaces with a 1px `border` hairline and at most one tonal step, and give a shadow only to a layer that floats, from the existing vocabulary.

Do keep hover instant. Fade only through the automatic-switch crossfade (the `theme-fade` class on the root: 1s ease, background colour only) and the Focus-mode chrome (150ms opacity), and drop both under reduced motion.
Do use Lucide icons at the 1.6 stroke and 14 to 19px, through `src/icons.ts`.
Do set vertical space in the editor as padding.

Do run `scripts/check-themes.mjs` after touching `src/themes.css` (ink 11, pencil 5, link 5.5, mark 4.5, quote 5.5, ink on selection and highlight 5, button text 4.5, destructive 4.5, ring 3, night syntax 7, all on paper), and declare any new role in all eleven blocks.
donts: Don't write a theme's hex anywhere but `src/themes.css`, or branch component CSS on a theme id. Scheme-wide differences go in the `[data-liubai-scheme=dark]` rules beside the tokens.
Don't colour body text, and don't colour links at night: dark themes keep link text ink and put the colour in the underline.
Don't add a gradient, a texture, ruled paper or a handwriting face; the paper is flat.
Don't dim or blur behind a panel whose job is to change what is behind it. The Appearance dialog has no scrim.
Don't crossfade between a light and a dark theme.
Don't bundle a font or name one that needs downloading, and don't give the chrome a theme's voice.
Don't theme exports or print: they stay white paper and black ink.
Don't reuse the Seasons spine on other cards; it is that swatch's own marker.
Don't imitate the stock editor theme packs (GitHub, Solarized, Nord, Dracula).
